test_cases.name: test_update_status_with_invalid_enum
test_cases.description: Attempt to update the task's status with an invalid enum value.

test_setup.given: A task object and an invalid status argument (e.g., a string 'DONE' not in TaskStatus).
test_setup.then: A ValueError or appropriate exception is raised, and the task's status is not updated.

test_cases.name: test_update_status_with_empty_string
test_cases.description: Attempt to update the task's status with an empty string as status.

test_setup.given: A task object and status argument is an empty string ('').
test_setup.then: A ValueError or appropriate exception is raised, and the task's status is not updated.

test_cases.name: test_update_status_with_invalid_type
test_cases.description: Attempt to update the task's status with a non-enum, non-string type (e.g., integer).

test_setup.given: A task object and status argument is an integer (e.g., 1).
test_setup.then: A TypeError or appropriate exception is raised, and the task's status is not updated.

test_cases.name: test_update_status_to_same_value
test_cases.description: Update the task's status to the same value it already has.

test_setup.given: A task object with status 'Completed' and status argument is TaskStatus.COMPLETED.
test_setup.then: The task's status remains 'Completed'. The function may or may not call update_status, but no error occurs.

test_cases.name: test_update_status_update_status_method_raises
test_cases.description: Simulate an exception raised by the task.update_status method.

test_setup.given: A task object whose update_status method raises an exception when called.
test_setup.when: update_task is called with a valid status argument.
test_setup.then: The exception is propagated or handled as per implementation, and the function does not silently ignore the error.
